# Wati

Wati is a WhatsApp Business API platform that automates marketing, sales, service, and support.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wati/.

## Actions

- **Add Contact**: Add a new contact in wati.
- **Get Teams**: Retrieve a list of teams from wati.
- **Send Session Message**: Send a session message to a specified whatsapp number.
- **Update Contact Attributes**: Update attributes of an existing contact.
- **Wati update chat status**: Deprecated action placeholder for updating chat status.
